input.quote: 14.10 Complete Understanding. This Agreement including all Exhibits, and the Non Disclosure Agreement and the Statement of Work referenced in this Agreement and incorporated by reference herein, constitutes the final, complete and exclusive agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof, and supersedes any prior or contemporaneous agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance provision anywhere. Section 14 (Miscellaneous) runs from assignment through complete understanding with no insurance covenant, the Section 8 indemnity imposes none, and searches for "insurance", "coverage", "certificate", "policy" and "workers compensation" return only the definitional deduction for freight and insurance in Section 1. Commerce One is a software licensor that also provides installation support, maintenance and training, so the playbook expects vendor insurance. We inserted the fallback position only (E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of USD 2,000,000) as the shortest complete clause; the preferred CGL, workers' compensation and certificate-on-request terms remain available if Commerce One prefers the fuller provision.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance clause (E&O USD 1M; cyber USD 2M) in Miscellaneous
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance clause, so we have added a short provision requiring Commerce One to carry errors and omissions coverage of USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy coverage of USD 2,000,000. This is our fallback insurance position for a software and support vendor.

ops.text: Insurance. Commerce One shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber liability and privacy insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.
